'''2026 Retro Worlds Alex Prodoehl LS Throne Room Mains''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex Prodoehl]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Alex Prodoehl]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Prodoehl LS Throne Room Mains.txt |Download]]
